data.title: KJ Simon gave Lulu and Georgia 3 stars. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 3 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-3.svg)

Jul 12, 2023

## [Eh! Not so great…just sayin’](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64ade5bb706f837cb10e128b)
The Wylie vases are a little small and unremarkable. I purchased them to fill a niche in a new wall unit which will be a feature wall in our new home. Just not very special but since they are black they will be fine…as we use groupings to make statements. Just not as great as we had originally thought when we saw them online…

July 11, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 13, 2023

Hi KJ, Thank you so much for your feedback, we have shared this with our teams. We’re so sorry to hear that you are not happy with the quality of the vases that you purchased. We are more than happy to help with some alternative suggestions such as offering a free return for your order. Feel free to reach out to us on Live Chat Monday-Friday 9am-5pm PST, email us at support@luluandgeorgia.com, and we can scheduled phone call back as well.
